integrity: All eleven classes have exact integer presentations and a complete reproducible verifier. Rational fixed and coinvariant groups are asserted abstractly isomorphic, not canonically.
scientific_limitations: The finite integral graph Jacobian is not identified with any Picard, Chow, Brauer or Neron-Severi group of the cubic threefold. Characteristic at least seven and the classical 10-node/15-plane configuration are assumed. Global historical priority is not certified.
title: Frobenius descent of the Segre-cubic node–plane graph Jacobian
